title: Location Course – Generate Courses – Location Selected – Location Course Created and Linked
description: CRUD – Generate (Scenario) – Click Generate Courses on a Course Master, select a Location, and verify a Location Course is created and linked to the Course Master.
preconditions:
- Logged in as HQ or CM Staff to the Salesforce org
- A Course Master GenLC_TC exists with no Location Course for Location_H001
- Location_H001 exists in the system
steps_actions:
1. "Open the detail page of GenLC_TC"
2. "Click Generate Courses"
3. "Leave Academic Year empty"
4. "Select Location_H001 in the Location field"
5. "Click Add"
6. "Click the Location Course tab on the Course Master detail page"
steps_result:
1. "Detail page opens; Location Course related list shows 0 items"
2. "Generate Course dialog opens with Academic Year and Location fields"
3. "Field remains blank"
4. "Location field shows Location_H001"
5. "Dialog closes; success feedback shown"
6. "Location Course list shows 1 item: GenLC_TC - Location_H001 linked to Account = Location_H001 and Course Master = GenLC_TC"

title: Location Course – Sync Data – New Location Course Synced to BO Course Location After Manual Sync
description: Sync – Manual Sync (Scenario) – Create a new Location Course in SF, trigger Sync Data from the Course Master list, and verify the record appears as a Course Location in the Back Office.
preconditions:
- Logged in as HQ or CM Staff to the Salesforce org
- A new Location Course SyncNewLC_TC - Location_H001 has been created and is not yet synced
- Logged in to the Back Office as HQ Staff
- Auto-sync has not yet run since creation
steps_actions:
1. "Confirm SyncNewLC_TC - Location_H001 exists in the SF Location Course list"
2. "In BO, search for the corresponding course location under the related course"
3. "In SF, navigate to the Course Master list and click Sync Data"
4. "Wait for sync to complete"
5. "In BO, search for the course location linked to SyncNewLC_TC"
steps_result:
1. "Record is present in SF"
2. "Location is NOT yet visible in BO course location"
3. "Sync is triggered; confirmation or progress indicator shown"
4. "Sync completes without error"
5. "Location_H001 now appears as a location under the corresponding BO course"

title: Location Course – Sync Data – Deleted Location Course Removed from BO Course Location After Manual Sync

preconditions:

steps_actions:

2. "In SF, delete SyncDelLC_TC - Location_H001"
3. "In BO, confirm Location_H001 is still visible (sync not yet triggered)"

steps_result:
1. "Location present in BO"
2. "Record deleted from SF"
3. "Location still present in BO"
4. "Sync triggered and completes without error"
5. "Location_H001 is no longer listed as a course location"

title: Location Course – Auto Sync – Location Course Synced to BO After Configured Interval
description: Sync – Auto Sync (State Transition) – Verify a new Location Course created in SF is automatically synced to the BO course location after the org-configured interval elapses without any manual trigger.
preconditions:
- Logged in as HQ or CM Staff to the Salesforce org
- Org auto-sync interval is configured (X hours per org setup)
- today = 2026-06-16; last_sync_time = known; next_sync_time = last_sync_time + X hours
- A Location Course AutoSyncLC_TC - Location_H001 was created after the last sync ran
- Logged in to the Back Office as HQ Staff
steps_actions:
1. "Confirm the location is NOT yet visible in BO course location immediately after creation"
2. "Wait until the next scheduled auto-sync time without clicking Sync Data"
3. "After auto-sync completes, check the BO course locations"
steps_result:
1. "Location absent from BO"
2. "System runs the auto-sync job automatically at the configured time"
3. "Location_H001 now appears as a course location for the corresponding BO course"
